title: Processo Seletivo 2027.1: Mestrado e Doutorado Acadêmico em Ciência da Computação
institution: Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE), Centro de Informática (CIn)
about: CIn-UFPE's academic graduate program in Computer Science is selecting students for 2027.1: 233 places (143 master's, 90 doctoral), including affirmative-action places. Registration on SIGAA closes 10 November 2026.
requirements: Master's: completed undergraduate or technologist degree in any field
Doctorate: master's degree in any field, recognised by CAPES or obtained abroad
Register on SIGAA (26/10 to 10/11) under 'CIn - Edital de Seleção do Programa de Pós-Graduação Acadêmico 2027.1'

upskill.name: the AI Foundations Academy page
why: No course objective covers the stated requirements ("completed undergraduate or technologist degree in any field"; "master's degree in any field, recognised by CAPES or obtained abroad"); shortlist matches were only the stem "comput" (top score 11.1 on name/topic overlap, not a genuine objective match).
Field "Computer science" → AI Foundations Academy topics (computing foundations), so the caption links to the Academy page, not a specific course.
